Title: Pahadi Mandua Ka Aata (Ragi / Finger Millet Flour)
Body (HTML):
Original high-altitude finger millet flour. Slowly stone-ground to keep vital nutrients intact.

Naturally gluten-free and loaded with calcium, iron, and fiber. Our Mandua (Ragi) flour is sourced from traditional crops grown in the chemical-free mountain soil of Uttarakhand. Stone-ground slowly in local watermills (Gharats) or traditional stone mills to avoid heating, ensuring that all dietary fibers and minerals are perfectly preserved.

Key Highlights:

  • Traditional Stone-Ground: Cold-milled slowly to lock in nutrients and minerals.
  • Gluten-Free & Nutrient-Dense: Naturally rich in calcium, dietary fibers, and iron.
  • Himalayan Sourced: Grown in high-altitude clean mountain air and pure soil.
